Scrapes a simple HTML page and extracts title, description, and links

```elixir title="Elixir"
engine_config = "{\"max_depth\":0,\"respect_robots_txt\":false}"
{:ok, engine} = Crawlberg.create_engine(engine_config)
url = "https://example.com"
result = Crawlberg.scrape_async(engine, url)
IO.inspect(result.status_code)
IO.inspect(result.content_type)
IO.inspect(result.html)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.title)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.description)
IO.inspect(result.metadata.canonical_url)
IO.inspect(length(result.links))
IO.inspect(Enum.at(result.links, 0).link_type)
IO.inspect(length(result.images))
IO.inspect(result.metadata.og_title)
```
